While revenue increased, the substantial decrease in net income and the substantial increase in deferred taxes are critical negative factors. The improved liquidity and slight improvement in the debt-to-equity ratio help to counterbalance the negative aspects, but are not enough to avoid a generally cautious outlook.  The large increase in deferred taxes is a significant red flag.
